DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the helper is GymnasiumDriver, not MujocoDriver, because robodesk.robodesk:RoboDesk is a gym.Env (robodesk/robodesk.py:16) whose reset()/step() wrap the MuJoCo physics, inverse kinematics and task rewards, and whose action_space is Box(-1, 1, (5,)) (README.md:109-115); a MujocoDriver would expose the raw actuator_ctrlrange/qpos/qvel instead of the environment action space. The decision family-config is unchanged. The gate does not import the clone, so the fake is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py); it does not integrate MuJoCo and was never compared with upstream. It returns a 4 x 4 x 3 image stand-in for the upstream default 64 x 64 x 3 (robodesk/robodesk.py:104-105, 19-20), a constant placeholder reward, and placeholder observations that mirror the upstream qpos_objects-from-qvel defect (robodesk/robodesk.py:385); it has no rendering. The fidelity contract is F0 for that deployed fake, with statistical determinism and seed_control none because upstream reset() takes no seed and draws from numpy's global generator (robodesk/robodesk.py:207-229); the gaps list all of this. Expected warnings, not cleared: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset in the bridge, so no environment call is made) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values, and the seed input of cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 (the same residual as the gymnasium exemplar; declaring family actions to add units exposes reset scenario/options and fails G6/G8). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
